title: Restore session data?
message: Session "aaaa-1111" cannot be read by this version of Rivetdeck. A verified checkpoint is available; its included sessions have capture times starting at __OLDEST_CAPTURE_TIME__.
detail:
A verified checkpoint can restore this session together with its related subagent sessions (1). The oldest included session copy was captured at __OLDEST_CAPTURE_TIME__.

Changes recorded after each session’s capture time will be hidden; this range can start as early as __OLDEST_CAPTURE_TIME__. The current files move to a new directory under quarantine /home/u/.dsh/electron/quarantine.

Keep every other DeepSeek Harness or Rivetdeck instance quit while the restore runs.

Rollback restores session history only — workspace files, external tool effects, and plugin data keep their current state, and a persisted schedule may still deliver into the restored session.
